title: TMC's Abhishek Banerjee appears before Bengal CID in case against his 'inflammatory' statements
description: The FIR against Mr. Banerjee over his alleged inflammatory statements was lodged exactly a month ago, based on a complaint filed by social activist Rajib Sarkar at Baguiati Police Station in North 24 Parganas district on May 5, a day after the assembly election results were declared
